text:
make a tiny helper and ban ad hoc byte math:

bytesOf(T, slice)
writeTypedBuffer(buffer, slice)

So no caller ever does count * sizeOf(T) manually again. The helper casts wide, checks overflow, checks expected size, and logs in debug. Same thing for row uploads, terrain vertices, instance rows, animation curves, everything.
resolution: Banned ad-hoc GPU byte math. The req_0842 road bug was a class bug: count*@sizeOf(T) where count came from @min(usize, COMPTIME_CONST) — Zig narrows that result to a u15 (fits 20000), so *4 overflowed and the upload truncated. New framework/gpu/buffer_upload.zig provides bytesOf(T,slice)/bytesOfCount(T,count) (size computed in u64, cannot overflow), writeTypedBuffer(queue,buf,offset,T,slice) (size derived from the slice's element type, bounds-checked + logged in safety builds), and writeValue(queue,buf,offset,&value) for single structs. Converted every queue.writeBuffer and every setVertexBuffer byte-range across the gpu layer (rects, capsules, curves, polys, sdf_icons, text glyphs, gcurve_fill, image quads, effect storage data, filter/brush/scene/sky uniforms, terrain vertices, instance rows, ground D stream) — no caller does count*@sizeOf by hand now. Builds clean (rjit ship). Verified the 3D mesh/instance path via the road-render-test gate (still PASS, asphalt everywhere); the 2D-primitive conversions are mechanically equivalent (same bytes for all non-overflowing cases) and compile, not separately eyeballed. Committed aad52d073.
